specs.Other Special Features of the Product: 22.5W Fast Charging, In Built Cables (8Pin + Type C), LED Display, Mach USB-A Output, Type C Port Input

features: 22.5W Portable Power Bank with Built-in Cables: Ditch the cables with this featherlight and small size power bank. This battery pack has 2 built-in cables- Type C cable and 8-pin cable. Directly plug your device into the power pack of 20,000mAh.
Triple Output: Charge 3 devices simultaneously with this 22.5-watt slim power bank’s 3 output ports- Mach USB A, in-built cables- Type C and 8 pin.

Luxury Charging Solution: Glam up your charging routine with this featherlight Luxcell Mini Bind 20K Power Bank, which combines lasting performance with stunning aesthetics. It has a lightweight and portable design that makes it easy to carry around.

Universal Device Charger: With triple outputs (Mach USB A output port, Type C, and 8 pin cables), Luxcell Mini Bind 20K can charge Android smartphones, iPhones, tablets, earbuds, and other 8 pin, Type C devices.
LED Battery Display: This 20000 mAh Fast charging Power bank has a transparent plastic casing with an LED battery Display , keeping you informed about the power bank and your device’s charge.
Type C input: Get a complementary USB to Type C cable as a bonus! Use this cable to charge up your small size power bank with rapid speed via the Type C input port.
BIS Certified: BIS certified with advanced chip protection layers, this durable power bank ensures your devices are safeguarded against short circuits, over-temperature, and over-voltage issues.
